title: An inverse coefficient problem for a semilinear wave equation by the first order linearization
summary: This paper investigates recovery of an unknown coefficient in a semilinear wave equation defined on a bounded, open, and strictly convex domain in \(\mathbb{R}^{1+n}\) with \(n \ge 2\). We demonstrate that the unknown coefficient \(q\) appearing in the semilinear wave equation \(\square u + q u^m = 0\) with Neumann boundary conditions can be reconstructed with Hölder stability from the linearized Neumann-to-Dirichlet (NtD) map.
